body:
Update classifyTrustRootAuthorization in packages/rails-guard/lib/trust-root-authorization.mjs to support optional teamMembers expansion and, when authorization fails on a path owned by an unexpanded @org/team entry, return a distinct actionable reason naming the team owner.

Acceptance criteria:
1. When owners contains an unexpanded team entry (org/team) and no individual owner has approved, classifyTrustRootAuthorization returns authorized: false with a reason naming the team and explaining that the ceremony cannot expand teams without team membership. Verify: node --test packages/rails-guard/test/trust-root-authorization.test.mjs
2. When an individual co-owner or a member of an expanded team in teamMembers approves, classifyTrustRootAuthorization returns authorized: true. Verify: node --test packages/rails-guard/test/trust-root-authorization.test.mjs
title: rails-guard: surface team CODEOWNERS reason and optional team expansion in trust-root ceremony (#1136)
